# Taskbar provider marks

The widget uses the OpenAI mark for Codex and the Grok, Claude and Gemini marks for their respective services. Each mark fits a 90-pixel box on a transparent 96-pixel canvas. OpenAI and Grok have black and white variants for contrast.

All four images derive from LobeHub Icons at commit `05260484d9f4de68f90cc87a634ae68fa4043efd`. [OpenAI](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-icons/blob/05260484d9f4de68f90cc87a634ae68fa4043efd/packages/static-svg/icons/openai.svg) · [Grok](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-icons/blob/05260484d9f4de68f90cc87a634ae68fa4043efd/packages/static-svg/icons/grok.svg) · [Claude](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-icons/blob/05260484d9f4de68f90cc87a634ae68fa4043efd/packages/static-svg/icons/claude-color.svg) · [Gemini](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-icons/blob/05260484d9f4de68f90cc87a634ae68fa4043efd/packages/static-svg/icons/gemini-color.svg) · [License](LobeIcons-LICENSE.txt)
